patterns.name: Root Account Console Login
patterns.description: Detects interactive AWS root credentials logging into the AWS Management Console.

patterns.name: Top Failed API Calls by Principal
patterns.description: Identifies authorization errors and access denied events across AWS identities.
patterns.cql: #repo = "aws-cloudtrail-logs" Vendor.errorCode = /^(AccessDenied|UnauthorizedOperation)$/ | groupBy([Vendor.userIdentity.principalId, Vendor.eventName, Vendor.eventSource], function=count(as=failure_count)) | sort(field=failure_count, order=desc)

patterns.name: Security Group Open to World (0.0.0.0/0)
patterns.description: Alerts when an ingress rule allowing traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 is added to any security group.

patterns.name: S3 Public Bucket Policy Modifications
patterns.description: Detects changes or deletions of S3 bucket policies and public access blocks.

patterns.name: Human Write Activity Session Landscape
patterns.description: Summarizes mutating actions performed by human SSO sessions vs automated service roles.
patterns.cql: #repo = "aws-cloudtrail-logs" Vendor.readOnly = false #event.outcome = "success" | regex("^(Create|Put|Update|Delete|Modify|Attach|Detach|Authorize|Revoke|Run|Start|Stop|Terminate)", field=Vendor.eventName) | groupBy([Vendor.userIdentity.type, Vendor.userIdentity.principalId, Vendor.userIdentity.sessionIssuer], function=count(as=write_count), limit=50) | sort(field=write_count, order=desc)
